DIPROM.name: “DIPROM” SME Loan Request Management System
DIPROM.organization: Department of Industrial Promotion, Ministry of Industry
detail: Developing the front-end for a centralized SME loan request platform, enabling borrower management, loan processing, accounting, and internal asset management to streamline staff operations.

TalentJourney.name: “Talent Journey” Registration and Point Management System
TalentJourney.organization: Department of Computer Engineering, Chulalongkorn University
detail: Led the development team, analyzed user requirements, and designed a weekly event registration system featuring real-time seat tracking and auto-filled user profiles to eliminate repetitive data entry.
The system centralizes all student participation score tracking while enabling students to submit score requests for external activities.
Serving 1,500+ active students across 100+ hosted activities and significantly streamlining the score verification workflow for staff.

PrineClass.name: “PrineClass” Tutoring Center Management Platform (ERP + LMS Platform)
detail: Analyzed user requirements, defined technical feature specifications, designed the SQL database schema, and developed an all-in-one management system for tutoring centers, integrating core ERP functions (Finance, HR), LMS features (Attendance Tracking, Learning Materials), and marketing features (Website, Blog).
Implemented an automated payment slip verification module with real-time transaction error detection, reducing review times by over 80%.
Successfully deployed to active tutoring centers with highly positive client feedback.

SummyShare.name: “SummyShare” Summary Marketplace Platform
detail: Defined system requirement, technical feature specifications, designed SQL database schema, and developed web-based marketplace for academic summary sheets.
Ensured a convenient trading process for both creators and buyers, enabling creators to generate over 10,000 Baht in income.

DIWLAB.name: “DIW LAB” Lab Registration and Renewal Platform
DIWLAB.organization: Department of Industrial Works, Ministry of Industry
detail: Developed the front-end for a lab registration and renewal platform, including automated request validation to streamline both lab and internal staff workflows.
